projects.name: Neural Acquisition and Synchronization
projects.problem: Connect acquisition files and behavioral event clocks to neural processing.
projects.tested: Reviewed probe/channel checks and the affine clock-fit implementation; timing logs and bench reports were unavailable.

bullets.text: Built Intan RHD ingestion, probe/channel checks, and SpikeInterface/Kilosort4 processing with waveform and quality-metric extraction.
Implemented queued PsychoPy/RHX event synchronization, exact-label joins, and affine clock fitting to analyze clock drift and alignment residuals.

projects.status: Acquisition workflow and clock-alignment software implemented; timing performance not independently verified.

projects.name: Neural Signal Fidelity and Processing Validation
projects.headline_result: 0.5 uV max difference across 20 million samples
projects.problem: Evaluate an existing DarkHorse Neuro conversion, not implement its compression algorithm.
projects.tested: Compared source CSC and reconstructed MED in physical units, then controlled for whole-microvolt rounding before identical offline sorting.

bullets.text: Evaluated DarkHorse Neuro compression on 20 million samples (one channel, 32 kHz; 625 s); maximum source-to-MED difference was 0.5 uV, with zero mismatches after rounding source values to whole microvolts.
Controlled MountainSort5 comparison of rounded inputs preserved all 35,587 spike frames for the compared unit (exact Jaccard 1.0).

projects.status: Offline validation on a bounded single-channel slice; archived outputs reviewed, not a new raw-data rerun.

projects.name: Spike Sorting and Waveform Discrimination
projects.problem: Quantify waveform-feature behavior against reference unit assignments.
projects.tested: Evaluated event-family WeightBank activations with nearest-neighbor purity and KMeans label matching on curated snippets.

bullets.text: Implemented waveform-feature evaluation across 38,145 spike snippets and 10 putative O-Sort unit labels; event-family KNN purity at k=5 was 95.04%.
Measured 54.26% Hungarian-matched KMeans accuracy (ARI 0.3665) for that feature family; neighborhood purity is not sorter accuracy or biological ground truth.

projects.status: Offline feature validation; streaming detection and competitive-learning sorting in SNNeuro remain prototypes.

dhn-fidelity.verification: Code and archived outputs cross-checked; raw source data unavailable for an independent rerun.
dhn-fidelity.measurement_definition: Elementwise CSC-minus-MED difference in microvolts; maximum absolute difference and nonzero count, before and after numpy.round of CSC.
dhn-fidelity.test_conditions: First 20,000,000 frames of one channel at 32,000 samples/s; MED contigua concatenated; physical-unit scaling.
dhn-fidelity.verified_result: 19,951,989 nonzero differences; maximum absolute error 0.5 uV. After whole-microvolt source rounding: zero mismatches. Compared duration is 625 s, derived as frames / sample rate.
dhn-fidelity.limitations: Not bit-exact relative to unrounded source. Mean error, compression ratio, file-size reduction, and encoder lossless/lossy settings are not established by these outputs. Do not generalize to complete sessions or other configurations.

visual.caption: One channel; 20,000,000 samples at 32,000 samples/s (625 s). Whole-uV rounding removes the observed differences; unrounded conversion is not bit-exact. No trace or error distribution is available.

sources.location: Code cells 0-5 (zero-based), especially saved cell 5 output

dhn-spike-control.verification: Archived code/output agreement inspected; no raw-data rerun or new sorting performed.
dhn-spike-control.measurement_definition: Exact intersection of the first sorted unit's spike-frame arrays; Jaccard = intersection / union with zero frame tolerance.
dhn-spike-control.test_conditions: Same 20-million-frame single-channel slice; both inputs scaled to uV and rounded to int32; canonical arrays asserted equal. Bandpass 300-6000 Hz; local whitening seed 0; MountainSort5 scheme 2 with internal filter/whiten disabled.
dhn-spike-control.verified_result: 35,587 CSC spikes and 35,587 MED spikes; 35,587 exact frame matches; no source-only events; exact Jaccard 1.0.
dhn-spike-control.limitations: Controlled consistency of equal rounded inputs, not proof of unrounded fidelity, biological unit correctness, all-unit conservation, real-time performance, or algorithm authorship.

visual.title: Exact spike-frame intersection
visual.caption: One compared unit, zero-frame tolerance. Identically rounded input arrays establish controlled sorting consistency, not fidelity of unrounded recordings or all-unit conservation.

sources.location: Dataset description, metric definitions, event-family result row

waveform-features.verification: Report checked against metric implementation; source waveform snippets not downloaded or reprocessed.
waveform-features.measurement_definition: KNN-k5 purity is mean same-label neighbor fraction, excluding self. Matched accuracy uses Hungarian cluster-to-label assignment. ARI is chance-corrected clustering agreement.
waveform-features.test_conditions: 38,145 spike snippets; 10 putative O-Sort labels; tier-3 features; event-family WeightBank with 10 bins, sigma_scale 1.0, threshold 0.5; KMeans 10 clusters, n_init 10, seed 42.
waveform-features.verified_result: Event family: KNN-k5 purity 0.9504; matched clustering accuracy 0.5426; ARI 0.3665.
waveform-features.limitations: Offline label-agreement analysis, not held-out classification accuracy, biological ground truth, or online sorting validation. Class imbalance and curated-snippet selection limit generalization.

visual.title: Local separability is not clustering agreement
visual.caption: Event-family features; 38,145 curated snippets and 10 putative O-Sort labels. These metric definitions differ; ARI is chance-corrected, not a percentage or biological accuracy.
visual.evidence_gap: Assignment counts and permission-safe waveform/features were not available for this publication. C1 waveform/projection and C2 contingency figures are withheld, not reconstructed from aggregate scores.
